{{Top|leg}}
A '''tour of duty''' was the term given to a period of time that [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] spent on combat duty. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] pilot [[Hesoc]] was rumored to constantly alter his enlistment date on his personnel records to extend his tour.
